title_zh: 选定教区追思活动的朗读内容

scenario.label_zh: 选定教区追思活动的朗读内容
scenario.goal_zh: 确认追思活动的家庭意愿，并选定朗读逝者写给花园志愿者的感谢信

context_zh: 虚构教区中，家属与主持追思活动的牧师商量朗读内容。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Miriam
sentences.text: Since my aunt’s passing, people in the parish have sent us such kind messages.

sentences.speaker: Pastor Cole
sentences.text: She meant a great deal to this community. We’re holding the gathering beside her memorial in the church garden. Is there anything you would like read aloud?

sentences.speaker: Miriam
sentences.text: We don’t want a long account of her illness. Could someone read her letter thanking the garden volunteers?

sentences.speaker: Pastor Cole
sentences.text: Of course. As the pastor leading the gathering, I can read it if that would help.

sentences.speaker: Miriam
sentences.text: Yes, please. That letter sounds like her, and the family is happy for you to read it.

sentences.speaker: Pastor Cole
sentences.text: Then we’ll use the letter and leave out the details of her illness.
